notes: Shelled creature (steamshell). Shelled-v1 rig template with turtle-like posture, basalt carapace with steam vents, timber skin, and water steam puffs. creature.large canvas (80x72, anchor 40,56).

fields.stance: standing on all four paws with its body horizontal, never sitting or standing upright
fields.description: a gentle grazer with little steam clouds venting above its volcanic shell
fields.anatomy: heavy domed volcanic basalt shell with twin steam exhaust vents along the upper carapace, four thick elephantine legs with flat padded toes, a blunt tortoise head with patient dark eyes, gentle neck extended forward, short thick tail
fields.colours: dark basalt volcanic rock shell, warm timber-brown textured skin, pale sand underbelly, soft cyan-white steam puffs venting from shell
